[1/5] Plan: camera pan/zoom/body tracking, relativistic 1PN precession, collision coalescence mode, interactive scenario switching, and remote push

impact_assessment.why: User requested all proposed advanced capabilities: camera control and body tracking, 1PN general relativistic precession, inelastic merger collisions, and live scenario switching.
impact_assessment.benefits: Elevates Orrery into a full astronomical observatory: study orbits from rotating reference frames (e.g. geocentric epicycles), observe Mercury's precession, simulate planetary accretion, and switch worlds dynamically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: default behaviour must remain unchanged; dependency: strictly standard library; concurrency: single-threaded event loop; state: merging modifies body array cleanly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Opt-in flags (--relativity, --merge) preserve existing defaults; trail recorder handles dynamic body counts on merger; tests cover all new modes.
